# Code tags

**Generated by `tools/tags.py`. Do not edit by hand** -- `python tools/tags.py --check` fails
if this file and the code disagree.

A tag marks a place in the code that other code or a doc relies on. To go to one, search the
file for the tag's name with `tag:` or `group:` in front of it. A group is the same thing done
in several places, which must be kept in step. The syntax is
[tagref's](https://github.com/stepchowfun/tagref); `tools/tags.py` explains it and checks it.

248 names in 297 places, and 53 references to them from 3 files.

## rule

A rule the code enforces. The tag sits on the check, or on the one setting that fixes the rule.

| name | where | what | pointed to from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rule.adjusted_in_panel` | [stage2/lib/contract.py](stage2/lib/contract.py) | the main panel carries the gap-adjusted form of each signal, never the unadjusted twin |  |
| `rule.column_contract` | [stage2/lib/contract.py](stage2/lib/contract.py) | the panel's 145 column names and their order are fixed; a build that changes them fails | `AGENTS.md` |
| `rule.complete_months` | [stage1/_stage1_settings.py](stage1/_stage1_settings.py) | the sample ends at the last complete month | `stage1/AGENTS.md` |
| `rule.connection_cap` | [stage0/_trace_settings.py](stage0/_trace_settings.py) | the members' CONCURRENCY together must leave one of WRDS's 7 connections free | `AGENTS.md`, `stage0/AGENTS.md` |
| `rule.daily_redaction` | [stage2/make_release.py](stage2/make_release.py) | the public daily file must not carry the licensed columns |  |
| `rule.fresh_process` | [stage2/build_panel.py](stage2/build_panel.py) | each group of steps runs in a fresh process; a long-lived one makes DuckDB lose its parallelism | `AGENTS.md` |
| `rule.frontier` | [stage2/lib/frontier.py](stage2/lib/frontier.py) | the panel's last month must be a real cross-section, not one TRACE database alone |  |
| `rule.holding_period` | [stage2/lib/contract.py](stage2/lib/contract.py) | hprd must equal the NYSE sessions between dt_s and dt_e |  |
| `rule.linker_window` | [stage1/_stage1_settings.py](stage1/_stage1_settings.py)<br>[stage2/_stage2_settings.py](stage2/_stage2_settings.py) | firm ids join the linker's identity window; stages 1 and 2 must agree | `stage1/AGENTS.md` |
| `rule.memory_per_slot` | [stage0/_trace_settings.py](stage0/_trace_settings.py) | memory is charged per slot and a job may use 8 slots and 48 GB; a larger request would wait in the queue forever, so this refuses it | `AGENTS.md`, `stage0/AGENTS.md` |
| `rule.mmn_twins` | [stage2/lib/contract.py](stage2/lib/contract.py) | every price-based signal ships with its unadjusted _mmn twin |  |
| `rule.numexpr` | [numeric_setup.py](numeric_setup.py) | pandas uses numexpr, as the published build did; it changes float32 results |  |
| `rule.parquet_only` | [stage0/_trace_settings.py](stage0/_trace_settings.py) | every stage reads parquet, so any other OUTPUT_FORMAT stops here | `stage0/AGENTS.md` |
| `rule.pybondlab_pin` | [pybondlab_pin.py](pybondlab_pin.py) | stages 2-4 stop at start-up unless PyBondLab is the pinned release and numba and numexpr are installed | `AGENTS.md` |
| `rule.redaction` | [stage2/make_release.py](stage2/make_release.py) | the public panel must have permco and gvkey blank and the ratings reduced to 1 (investment grade) or 11 (high yield) | `AGENTS.md` |

## col

Where a column of the stage 2 monthly panel is computed. Of the 38 price-based signals (`MMN_TWINNED` in stage2/lib/contract.py), the panel carries the gap-adjusted form, read at the signal trade or without the bond's last day of trading in the month, and the `_mmn` sidecar the unadjusted one.

| name | where | what | pointed to from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `col.144a` | [stage2/steps/step7_final.py](stage2/steps/step7_final.py) | 1 if FISD marks the bond Rule 144A, else 0 |  |
| `col.age` | [stage2/steps/step1_returns.py](stage2/steps/step1_returns.py) | years since issue at the month-end trade (stage 1's bond_age) |  |
| `col.ami` | [stage2/lib/illiq_pandas.py](stage2/lib/illiq_pandas.py) | Amihud illiquidity: the month's mean of \|log return\| over dollar volume |  |
| `col.ami_v` | [stage2/lib/illiq_pandas.py](stage2/lib/illiq_pandas.py) | the standard deviation of the same daily ratios |  |
| `col.ar_sprd` | [stage2/steps/step2_illiquidity.py](stage2/steps/step2_illiquidity.py) | the Abdi-Ranaldo spread from close, high and low prices, the month's average |  |
| `col.b_amd` | [stage2/lib/betas.py](stage2/lib/betas.py) | beta on the Amihud factor, with MKTB alongside |  |
| `col.b_amd_m` | [stage2/lib/betas.py](stage2/lib/betas.py) | beta on AMD (Amihud), with FF3, MKTBx and TERM alongside |  |
| `col.b_coskew` | [stage2/lib/betas.py](stage2/lib/betas.py) | coskewness: beta on MKTB squared, with MKTB alongside |  |
| `col.b_cpi_vol6` | [stage2/lib/betas.py](stage2/lib/betas.py) | beta on inflation volatility (six-month CPI volatility), with MKTB alongside |  |
| `col.b_cptlt` | [stage2/lib/betas.py](stage2/lib/betas.py) | beta on the traded intermediary capital factor, with MKTRF alongside |  |
| `col.b_credit` | [stage2/lib/betas.py](stage2/lib/betas.py) | beta on the BAA-AAA spread level, with MKTB alongside |  |
| `col.b_crf` | [stage2/lib/betas.py](stage2/lib/betas.py) | beta on the credit risk factor CRF alone |  |
| `col.b_dcpi` | [stage2/lib/betas.py](stage2/lib/betas.py) | beta on CPI inflation, with MKTB alongside |  |
| `col.b_dcredit` | [stage2/lib/betas.py](stage2/lib/betas.py) | beta on the change in the BAA-AAA spread, with MKTB alongside |  |
